description: What is gua sha? Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain. In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion. Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle. Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery. The use of Bian stones for healing is centuries-old. In the “Nei Jing”, an ancient Chinese Medical book, it lists “acupuncture, moxibustion, herbal medicine, Qigong, and Bian stone therapy” as the five major medical practices of the “Yellow Emperor”, a deity in Chinese religion. What’s amazing is that Bian stone therapy predates acupuncture.

description:
The Rosewood Santoku Knife is a Japanese style knife known for its versatility. Santoku translates to "three virtues" or "three uses" which refers to the three types of cuts this knife is made for: slicing, dicing, and mincing. It combines features of both a chef's knife and a cleaver. The wide blade is perfect for scooping sliced or chopped ingredients off the cutting board and transferring them into a pot or bowl. The triad of abilities this knife possesses makes it a must-have for every home chef. Featuring a flat cutting edge and a rounded tip called a sheep's foot, the Rosewood Santoku's unique shape makes it a stand-out from other kitchen knives. The flat edge doesn't rock on the cutting surface, which distinguishes it from a chef's knife, and provides a highly efficient motion for slicing, dicing, and mincing. The Granton blade, also referred to as a hollow or fluted edge, features hollowed-out grooves or dimples on both sides on the blade. Depending on what is being cut, these grooves will fill with juices or create pockets of air, which prevents food from sticking to the blade and creates less friction to allow for easier motion when chopping.

El cuchillo Santoku de palisandro es un cuchillo de estilo japonés conocido por su versatilidad. Santoku se traduce en "tres virtudes" o "tres usos" que se refiere a los tres tipos de cortes que este cuchillo está hecho para: rebanar, cortar en cubitos y picar. Combina características tanto de un cuchillo de chef como de una cuchilla. La hoja ancha es perfecta para recoger ingredientes en rodajas o picados de la tabla de cortar y transferirlos a una olla o tazón. La tríada de habilidades que posee este cuchillo lo convierte en un imprescindible para cada chef casero. Con un filo plano y una punta redondeada llamada pie de oveja, la forma única de Rosewood Santoku lo hace un destaque entre otros cuchillos de cocina. El borde plano no rocía en la superficie de corte, lo que lo distingue del cuchillo de un chef, y proporciona un movimiento altamente eficiente para cortar, cortar y picar. La hoja Granton, también conocida como un borde hueco o estriado, cuenta con ranuras o hoyuelos ahuecados en ambos lados de la cuchilla. Dependiendo de lo que se esté cortando, estas ranuras se llenarán de jugos o crearán bolsillos de aire, lo que evita que los alimentos se peguen a la cuchilla y crea menos fricción para permitir un movimiento más fácil al picar.

סכין סנטוקו Rosewood הוא סכין בסגנון יפני הידוע ברבגוניות שלו. Santoku מתורגם ל"שלוש מעלות" או "שלושה שימושים" המתייחסים לשלושה סוגי החיתוכים הסכין הזו מיועדת ל: חיתוך, קוביות וקיצוץ. הוא משלב תכונות של סכין שף ומקוצץ. הלהב הרחב מושלם לגריפת מרכיבים חתוכים או קצוצים מקרש החיתוך והעברתם לתוך סיר או קערה. שלישיית היכולות שיש לסכין הופכת אותו לפריט חובה לכל שף ביתי. כולל קצה חיתוך שטוח וקצה מעוגל הנקרא כף רגל של כבשה, הצורה הייחודית של Rosewood Santoku הופכים אותה לבולטת מסכיני מטבח אחרים. הקצה השטוח אינו מתנדנד על משטח החיתוך, המבדיל אותו מסכין שף, ומספק תנועה יעילה ביותר לחיתוך, לקוביות ולקיצוץ. להב Granton, המכונה גם קצה חלול או מחורץ, כולל חריצים חלולים או גומות משני הצדדים על הלהב. תלוי במה שנחתך, החריצים האלה ימלאו במיצים או ייצרו כיסי אוויר, אשר מונעים מהאוכל להידבק ללהב ויוצרת פחות חיכוך כדי לאפשר תנועה קלה יותר בעת חיתוך.

Das Rosewood Santoku-Messer ist ein japanischer Stil, bekannt für seine Vielseitigkeit. Santoku bedeutet "drei Tugenden" oder "drei Anwendungen", was sich auf die drei Arten von Schnitten bezieht, für die dieses Messer gemacht ist: Schneiden, Würfeln und Hacken. Es vereint Funktionen von Kochmesser und Hackbeil Die breite Klinge ist perfekt zum Schöpfen von geschnittenen oder gehackten Zutaten vom Schneidebrett und zum Übertragen in einen Topf oder eine Schüssel. Der Dreiertel von Fähigkeiten, die dieses Messer besitzt, macht es zu einem Must-Have für jeden Hobbykoch. Mit einer flachen Schneide und einer abgerundeten Spitze, die als Schaffuß bezeichnet wird, macht das Rosewood Santoku eine einzigartige Form zu einem Blickfang von anderen Küchenmessern. Die flache Kante wippt nicht auf der Schneidefläche, was sie von einem Kochmesser unterscheidet, und bietet eine hocheffiziente Bewegung zum Schneiden, Würfeln und Hacken. Die Granton-Klinge, auch als hohler oder geriffelter Rand bezeichnet, verfügt über ausgehöhlte Rillen oder Vertiefungen auf beiden Seiten der Klinge. Je nachdem, was geschnitten wird, füllen diese Rillen mit Säften oder schaffen Lufttaschen, die verhindern, dass Lebensmittel an der Klinge haften bleiben und weniger Reibung erzeugen, um eine einfachere Bewegung beim Hacken zu ermöglichen.

سكين سانتوكو من روزوود هو سكين ياباني معروف بتنوع استخداماته. تترجم سانتوكو إلى "ثلاثة مراحل" أو "ثلاثة استخدامات" التي تشير إلى الأنواع الثلاثة من القطع التي صُنعت هذه السكين من أجل: التقطيع والتقطيع والفرم. يجمع بين ميزات سكين الطهاة وساطعة. الشفرة العريضة مثالية لغَرْف المكونات المقطعة أو المقطعة من لوح التقطيع ونقلها إلى وعاء أو وعاء. ثلاث قدرات يمتلكها هذا السكين يجعلها جديرة بالاقتناء لكل طباخ منزلي. يتميز بحافة قص مسطحة وطرف دائري يسمى قدم الخنم، والشكل الفريد من نوعه لخشب السانتوكو يجعله مميزًا عن سكاكين المطبخ الأخرى. الحافة المسطحة لا تهتز على سطح التقطيع، مما يميزها عن سكين الطباخ، وتوفر حركة فعالة للغاية للتقطيع والفرم. شفرة جرانتون، يشار إليها أيضًا بحافة مجوفة أو مخددة، تتميز بأخاديد أو قطرات مجوفة على كلا الجانبين على الشفرة. اعتمادًا على ما يتم تقطيعه، ستملأ هذه الأخاديد بالعصائر أو تخلق جيوباً من الهواء، مما يمنع الطعام من الالتصاق بالشفرة ويخلق احتكاك أقل للسماح بحركة أسهل عند التقطيع.

A faca Santoku de jacarandá é uma faca de estilo japonês conhecida por sua versatilidade. Santoku se traduz em "três virtudes" ou "três usos" que se refere aos três tipos de cortes que esta faca é feita para: fatiar, cortar e picar. Combina características tanto de uma faca de chef quanto de um cutelo. A lâmina larga é perfeita para colher ingredientes fatiados ou picados da tábua de corte e transferi-los para uma panela ou tigela. A tríade de habilidades que esta faca possui torna esta faca um item essencial para cada chefe de casa. Com uma ponta plana e uma ponta arredondada chamada de pé de ovelha, a forma única de jacarandá Santoku faz com que seja um destaque de outras facas de cozinha. A borda plana não balança na superfície de corte, o que a distingue de uma faca de chefe e oferece um movimento altamente eficiente para fatiar, cortar e picar. A lâmina Granton, também conhecida como uma borda oca ou canelada, possui ranhuras vazadas ou covinhas em ambos os lados da lâmina. Dependendo do que está sendo cortado, estes sulcos vão preencher com sucos ou criar bolsos de ar, o que evita que os alimentos grudem na lâmina e cria menos fricção para permitir um movimento mais fácil ao picar.

Rosewood 三德刀是一款以多功能性聞名的日式刀。 Santoku 翻譯成「三種美德」或「三種用途」,指的是這款刀子的三種切割類型:切片、切塊和切碎。 它結合了廚師刀和切肉刀的特點。 寬刀片非常適合從砧板上舀出切片或切碎的食材,並將其轉移到鍋或碗中。 ​ 這款刀具有的三重能力使其成為每個家庭廚師的必備品。 ​ Rosewood Santoku 擁有平坦的切割邊緣和稱為羊腳的圓形尖端,其獨特的形狀使其與眾不同。 平坦的邊緣不會搖擺在切割表面上,這將它與廚師刀區分開,並提供高效的運動來進行切片、切塊和切碎。 Granton 刀片也稱為空心或凹槽邊緣,刀片兩側都有鏤空凹槽或凹槽。 這些凹槽將填充果汁或形成空氣袋,防止食物粘在刀片上,產生更少的摩擦,以便在切碎時更輕鬆地移動。

红木三德刀是一款以多功能性而闻名的日式刀。 三德翻译成"三美德"或"三种用途",指的是这款刀具的三种切割:切片、切碎和切碎。 它结合了厨师刀和刀叉。 宽刀片非常适合从砧板上舀取切片或切碎的食材,并将其转移到锅或碗中。 这款刀具有三重能力,使其成为每个家庭厨师的必备品。 具有平切边缘和一个叫羊脚的圆尖,玫瑰木三德的独特形状使其比其他厨房刀具脱颖而出。 扁平边缘不会在切割表面摇摆,这与厨师刀区别开来,并且在切片、切碎和切碎时提供高效的动作。 Granton 刀片也被称为中空或凹槽边缘,刀片两侧有镂空凹槽或凹槽。 根据切割的内容,这些凹槽将填充果汁或产生空气袋,从而防止食物粘在刀片上,减少摩擦,从而在切碎时更容易运动。

description:
The Rosewood Santoku Knife is a Japanese style knife known for its versatility. Santoku translates to "three virtues" or "three uses" which refers to the three types of cuts this knife is made for: slicing, dicing, and mincing. It combines features of both a chef's knife and a cleaver. The wide blade is perfect for scooping sliced or chopped ingredients off the cutting board and transferring them into a pot or bowl. The triad of abilities this knife possesses makes it a must-have for every home chef. Featuring a flat cutting edge and a rounded tip called a sheep's foot, the Rosewood Santoku's unique shape makes it a stand-out from other kitchen knives. The flat edge doesn't rock on the cutting surface, which distinguishes it from a chef's knife, and provides a highly efficient motion for slicing, dicing, and mincing. The Granton blade, also referred to as a hollow or fluted edge, features hollowed-out grooves or dimples on both sides on the blade. Depending on what is being cut, these grooves will fill with juices or create pockets of air, which prevents food from sticking to the blade and creates less friction to allow for easier motion when chopping.

El cuchillo Santoku de palisandro es un cuchillo de estilo japonés conocido por su versatilidad. Santoku se traduce en "tres virtudes" o "tres usos" que se refiere a los tres tipos de cortes que este cuchillo está hecho para: rebanar, cortar en cubitos y picar. Combina características tanto de un cuchillo de chef como de una cuchilla. La hoja ancha es perfecta para recoger ingredientes en rodajas o picados de la tabla de cortar y transferirlos a una olla o tazón. La tríada de habilidades que posee este cuchillo lo convierte en un imprescindible para cada chef casero. Con un filo plano y una punta redondeada llamada pie de oveja, la forma única de Rosewood Santoku lo hace un destaque entre otros cuchillos de cocina. El borde plano no rocía en la superficie de corte, lo que lo distingue del cuchillo de un chef, y proporciona un movimiento altamente eficiente para cortar, cortar y picar. La hoja Granton, también conocida como un borde hueco o estriado, cuenta con ranuras o hoyuelos ahuecados en ambos lados de la cuchilla. Dependiendo de lo que se esté cortando, estas ranuras se llenarán de jugos o crearán bolsillos de aire, lo que evita que los alimentos se peguen a la cuchilla y crea menos fricción para permitir un movimiento más fácil al picar.

סכין סנטוקו Rosewood הוא סכין בסגנון יפני הידוע ברבגוניות שלו. Santoku מתורגם ל"שלוש מעלות" או "שלושה שימושים" המתייחסים לשלושה סוגי החיתוכים הסכין הזו מיועדת ל: חיתוך, קוביות וקיצוץ. הוא משלב תכונות של סכין שף ומקוצץ. הלהב הרחב מושלם לגריפת מרכיבים חתוכים או קצוצים מקרש החיתוך והעברתם לתוך סיר או קערה. שלישיית היכולות שיש לסכין הופכת אותו לפריט חובה לכל שף ביתי. כולל קצה חיתוך שטוח וקצה מעוגל הנקרא כף רגל של כבשה, הצורה הייחודית של Rosewood Santoku הופכים אותה לבולטת מסכיני מטבח אחרים. הקצה השטוח אינו מתנדנד על משטח החיתוך, המבדיל אותו מסכין שף, ומספק תנועה יעילה ביותר לחיתוך, לקוביות ולקיצוץ. להב Granton, המכונה גם קצה חלול או מחורץ, כולל חריצים חלולים או גומות משני הצדדים על הלהב. תלוי במה שנחתך, החריצים האלה ימלאו במיצים או ייצרו כיסי אוויר, אשר מונעים מהאוכל להידבק ללהב ויוצרת פחות חיכוך כדי לאפשר תנועה קלה יותר בעת חיתוך.

Das Rosewood Santoku-Messer ist ein japanischer Stil, bekannt für seine Vielseitigkeit. Santoku bedeutet "drei Tugenden" oder "drei Anwendungen", was sich auf die drei Arten von Schnitten bezieht, für die dieses Messer gemacht ist: Schneiden, Würfeln und Hacken. Es vereint Funktionen von Kochmesser und Hackbeil Die breite Klinge ist perfekt zum Schöpfen von geschnittenen oder gehackten Zutaten vom Schneidebrett und zum Übertragen in einen Topf oder eine Schüssel. Der Dreiertel von Fähigkeiten, die dieses Messer besitzt, macht es zu einem Must-Have für jeden Hobbykoch. Mit einer flachen Schneide und einer abgerundeten Spitze, die als Schaffuß bezeichnet wird, macht das Rosewood Santoku eine einzigartige Form zu einem Blickfang von anderen Küchenmessern. Die flache Kante wippt nicht auf der Schneidefläche, was sie von einem Kochmesser unterscheidet, und bietet eine hocheffiziente Bewegung zum Schneiden, Würfeln und Hacken. Die Granton-Klinge, auch als hohler oder geriffelter Rand bezeichnet, verfügt über ausgehöhlte Rillen oder Vertiefungen auf beiden Seiten der Klinge. Je nachdem, was geschnitten wird, füllen diese Rillen mit Säften oder schaffen Lufttaschen, die verhindern, dass Lebensmittel an der Klinge haften bleiben und weniger Reibung erzeugen, um eine einfachere Bewegung beim Hacken zu ermöglichen.

What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain. In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion. Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle. Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain.
In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion.
Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle.
Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

Myofascial Trigger Points

When the body exercises it creates small, painful areas of muscle that can be sore and hurts to touch. The medical term for these knots are myofascial trigger points. It occurs when a band of tissue, “fascia” becomes tense. They can affect an athlete's range of motion. Allowing this knot to remain tight sends pain signals throughout the body and increase stress hormones. The pain can radiate to other areas. The tension can pull on ligaments and tendons leading to pain in the joints.

Myotherapy

Myotherapy is a form of treatment to release myofascial trigger points. There are many forms of myotherapy, the most popular being Soft Tissue Therapy. Soft tissue therapy targets specific areas with manual pressure to release the tension in myofascial.

description:
THE MYOFASCIAL RELEASE MIRACLE ~ Fascia is a thin sheath of fibrous tissue that wraps around every muscle in the body. When you've been injured or your muscles are tight, you get what physical therapists call 'myofascial pain' which comes from the thickening of the fascia. What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain. In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion. Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle. Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

What is Cupping Massage?
Cupping massage is a modern adaptation of ancient cupping therapy. Cupping massage uses gentle suction to stimulate circulation and detoxification and help tone and smooth the skin.
One of the most effective uses of cupping massage is for body contouring and cellulite reduction.
Unlike cellulite creams that don’t penetrate below the surface of the skin, cupping massage targets the deeper tissues of the body – helping eliminate cellulite from the inside out.

Benefits of Cellulite Cupping
Stimulates circulation
Increases lymph flow and detoxification
Helps release trapped toxins and fluids
Breaks up cellulite deposits
Helps improve skin tone and firmness

We recommend that you use the medium cup for larger areas of the body, like the thighs and behind. The small cup is ideal for smaller areas like the arms, stomach, knees, and calves.
These soft cups conform to the body and can be easily controlled for as light or deep a massage as you like.
The unique shape of these cups makes them easier to grip than basic cup styles, so they're particularly handy when working on the back of the body.

Directions for Use
STEP 1: Apply body oil, lotion, or shower gel to allow the cup to glide over the skin.
STEP 2: Press down on the top of the cup and apply the cup to the skin.
STEP 3: Massage the cup over your skin, targeting cellulite-prone areas. Use up and down, zig zag, and circulation motions.

Combined with a healthy diet and regular exercise, the Cups offer a remarkably effective way to achieve a sleeker, smoother silhouette in only minutes per day!
Note: Do not apply too much pressure or leave the cup in the same place for too long as this can result in bruising. Use light suction until your skin has gotten accustomed to the treatment.

What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain. In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion. Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle. Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain.
In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion.
Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle.
Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain. In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion. Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle. Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

description: Lacrosse ball massage is a form of self-myofascial release. Fascia, or the connective tissue that covers all our muscles and organs are often overlooked and can cause pain, muscle imbalances and poor movement patterns. Tight fascia are pulling the body out of alignment increasing pressure on joints and muscles. The goal of myofascial therapy is to loosen and stretch the fascia in order the underlying tissue to move freely. Self-myofascial release is best conducted after a workout, but you can also do it throughout the day. It takes just a few minutes. Like stretching, the best results are observed after consistent practice. TRIGGER POINT DEACTIVATION Trigger points, also known as muscle knots, are the spots which are located on specific spots on muscles. They are one of the most common sources of referred pain, which means that when the trigger points are pressed or activated, pain is felt somewhere else in the body. You may have a trigger point in your glute that causes pain in your low back. Lacrosse Balls are one of the self-applied tools for releasing trigger points. By using the Lacrosse Ball to apply consistent pressure to them, the trigger points are released (deactivated). The muscles are eased and the pain is gone. The pressure may be painful at first, but after treatment the muscles will feel noticeably eased and relaxed.

What is gua sha?
Gua sha is a natural, alternative therapy that involves scraping your skin with a massage tool to improve your circulation. This ancient Chinese healing technique may offer a unique approach to better health, addressing issues like chronic pain.
In gua sha, a technician scrapes your skin with short or long strokes to stimulate microcirculation of the soft tissue, which increases blood flow. They make these strokes with a smooth-edged instrument known as a gua massage tool. The technician applies massage oil to your skin, and then uses the tool to repeatedly scrape your skin in a downward motion.
Gua sha is intended to address stagnant energy, called chi, in the body that practitioners believe may be responsible for inflammation. Inflammation is the underlying cause of several conditions associated with chronic pain. Rubbing the skin’s surface is thought to help break up this energy, reduce inflammation, and promote healing. Gua sha is generally performed on a person’s back, buttocks, neck, arms, and legs. A gentle version of it is even used on the face as a facial technique. Your technician may apply mild pressure, and gradually increase intensity to determine how much force you can handle.
Gua sha ( Chinese : 刮痧 ) is a traditional Chinese medical treatment in which the skin is scraped to produce light petechiae. Practitioners believe that gua sha releases unhealthy bodily matter from blood stasis within sored, tired, stiff or injured muscle areas to stimulate new oxygenated blood flow to the areas, thus promotes metabolic cell repair, regeneration, healing and recovery.

The Neptune Mobility Ball (Dark Blue) by Invictus Fitness Gear is an amazing mobility tool used to release muscle tension cause by knots. The Neptune was created to take up a large surface area, suiting it well to muscles such as the calves, hamstrings, glutes, quads, lats and pectorals. It also does a great job at reach the psoas. Myofascial Trigger Points

When the body exercises it creates small, painful areas of muscle that can be sore and hurts to touch. The medical term for these knots are myofascial trigger points. It occurs when a band of tissue, “fascia” becomes tense. They can affect an athlete's range of motion. Allowing this knot to remain tight sends pain signals throughout the body and increase stress hormones. The pain can radiate to other areas. The tension can pull on ligaments and tendons leading to pain in the joints.

Myotherapy

Myotherapy is a form of treatment to release myofascial trigger points. There are many forms of myotherapy, the most popular being Soft Tissue Therapy. Soft tissue therapy targets specific areas with manual pressure to release the tension in myofascial.

أضف الضغط إلى تدليك القدم الساخن للحصول على شعور أعمق لتخفيف الألم. يستخدم الضغط ضغطًا لطيفًا متناغمًا لمنح قدميك تدليكًا مهدئًا. اختر من بين كثافة الضغط المنخفضة أو المتوسطة أو العالية.

يستخدم جهاز تدليك شياتسو من هوميديكس عقد عميقة لتخفيف الألم في قدميك المتعبتين. سيجعلك تعتقد أنك غادرت منزلك وتتلقى تدليكًا احترافيًا في منتجع صحي باهظ الثمن.

جهاز تدليك القدم هذا سهل التنظيف والتخزين. للتخزين، ضع جهاز التدليك في مكان آمن وجاف وبارد. تجنب ملامسة الحواف الحادة أو الأشياء المدببة. لتجنب الكسر، لا تقم بلف سلك الطاقة حول الوحدة. لا تعلق الوحدة بسلك وحدة التحكم. للتنظيف، افصل الوحدة واتركها تبرد قبل التنظيف. تنظف فقط بإسفنجة ناعمة ورطبة قليلاً. لا تدع الماء أو أي سوائل أخرى تلامس الوحدة.
